summary: Iteration 62 — Owner-controlled Team Hub access delegation. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed covering GET /api/team-access (owner shape with is_owner/owner_user_id/members/invites), PATCH /api/team-access/members/{user_id} (owner-self toggle off→on, 404 for non-member, Team Hub gated by resulting team_access), POST /api/team-access/invite (new-email invited code path + granted:true when email is already a household member), DELETE /api/team-access/invite/{id} (revoke + 404 unknown), non-owner 403 on PATCH/POST/DELETE, and /api/household/join with grant_team_access flipping the joiner's team_access to true (response includes team_access:true). Frontend: verified Settings row testID=settings-team-access navigates to /team-access; owner screen shows household members with team-access-toggle-<userId> Switch, invite email input + submit, and pending invites with share/revoke controls. Team tab locked-state 'Manage access' button (testID team-add-staff) present only when locked (owner is unlocked so button correctly hidden — verified via code and unlocked-state intro text). Post-test cleanup: leftover TEST_ pending invites revoked; owner team_access restored to true.
critical_code_review_comments: team_access.py invite endpoint lower-cases the email server-side (correct); noted for FE parity — the confirmation Alert shows the code, and the returned email in GET /api/team-access invites is lower-case.
helpers._get_or_create_household correctly back-fills owner_user_id for legacy households (first member becomes owner).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ users and invites created during tests; all cleaned up (household leave + invite revoke). Owner (applereview) team_access verified true at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter62_team_access_delegation.py as regression. Login credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. If adding tests around household join with grant_team_access, remember /api/household/join returns {joined,household_id,team_access}. All /api/team-access/* endpoints are owner-gated via _require_owner (403 otherwise).
